rules: Treat every catalog URL as an unverified locator until a later authorized retrieval succeeds.
Retrieve only material that is publicly accessible without credentials and whose use is allowed; never bypass authentication, paywalls, access controls, or robots and rate limits.
Do not retrieve staff-only material, solutions, hidden graders, sealed references, secrets, or another learner's work.
Keep source repositories read-only and copy permitted learner inputs only into the later attempt workspace.
For each successful retrieval, record the canonical URL, retrieval time, content hash, license or access basis, content type, and explicit learner-safe or examiner-only classification.
If a locator fails, redirects unexpectedly, changes content, or has unclear rights, preserve the failure as blocked evidence and do not infer availability from the catalog claim.
Promote material to a graph unit only after its content, provenance, dependencies, scope, and harness-controlled validation path are explicit.
later_expansion_order: Verify the public course website and identify a syllabus or schedule.
Resolve individual textbook readings and recording URLs against that schedule.
Locate assignment prompts separately from solutions and staff-only infrastructure.
Create one provenance-bearing graph node per validated instructional or assessed unit.
